task_completion.description: The telescope is unparked to allow for observations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The telescope control software (e.g., KStars/Ekos or similar) shows the mount status as 'Unparked' or the tracking/slewing controls are enabled.

task_completion.description: CCD settings are configured for 5-second LIGHT frame exposures.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The camera control interface shows 'Exposure' set to 5.0s and 'Type' or 'Frame' set to 'Light'.

task_completion.description: Observations are conducted for the 8 specified reference stars.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the telescope slewing to or capturing images of Polaris, Capella, Regulus, Arcturus, Vega, Altair, Deneb, and Fomalhaut.

task_completion.description: Images are saved in the correct directory structure (/home/ga/Images/pointing_model/<star_name>/).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or terminal window shows subdirectories for each star (e.g., /vega/, /polaris/) containing FITS or image files within the /home/ga/Images/pointing_model/ path.

task_completion.description: A TPoint-format pointing model file is created at /home/ga/Documents/pointing_model.dat.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output displays the contents of /home/ga/Documents/pointing_model.dat containing coordinate data for the 8 stars.

task_completion.description: The final sky view image is generated using the specified script.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent runs ~/capture_sky_view.sh and the file ~/Images/pointing_model/final_sky.png is visible in the file system.

integrity.description: The agent used the astronomical software GUI for telescope control and image capture.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse interactions with buttons like 'Slew', 'Capture', or 'Unpark' in the telescope/CCD control software rather than just CLI scripts.

integrity.description: The agent performed the observations sequentially rather than instantly generating all files.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timestamps on the screenshots and the progress bars in the capture software show a logical progression of slewing and exposing for different stars.

integrity.description: The pointing model data was derived from the session, not just copy-pasted from the spec.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen interacting with the software to get coordinates or the pointing model file creation shows dynamic input.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 8 required stars are: polaris, capella, regulus, arcturus, vega, altair, deneb, fomalhaut. Exposure time must be exactly 5 seconds. The pointing model file must be at /home/ga/Documents/pointing_model.dat. The image directory is /home/ga/Images/pointing_model/. The telescope must be unparked before capture. The final sky view is created by ~/capture_sky_view.sh.
